opening: This first act edits all three roots, with every value known at plan. A new subnet comes in the second.

pull-request.reply: Opened pull request {pull}. network changes the proxy port and adds an admin port; app and edge follow both. Next: plan all three.

pull-request.status: Planning network, app and edge together

tips.title: One plan, three roots
tips.body: With terraform.compose on, chant writes one root that calls network, app and edge as modules and plans it once. It posts one note with one digest.

tips.title: Every value known
tips.body: A port in the source is a plain value, so the plan knows what network will output before it applies. App and edge are planned on the new port in the same plan.

planned.reply: One plan across 3 roots. Every value is known at plan, so each card shows before and after: {creates} to create, {updates} to change.

approved.status: Recording your approval on the pull request

tips.title: One approval
tips.body: The approval binds the digest of the one plan. On merge chant plans the three roots again under their state locks and applies only if that plan has the same digest.

merged.status: Merging and applying network, app and edge in one pass

tips.title: Variables, not remote state
tips.body: Each root reads the one before it through variables that chant fills from its outputs with stackOutput. In the composed run those become module outputs, so a new value reaches its readers inside the one apply.

applying.status: Applying network, app and edge together

tips.title: Each root keeps its own state
tips.body: The composed apply works on a merged copy of the three states and writes each root's part back to its own state when it ends.

tips.title: A stock chant project
tips.body: These are three Terraform roots in a chant project. The pull request pipeline is the one chant generates for the project. No other tool is in it.

applied.reply: Done. Both ports changed in network, app and edge in the same apply.
